core_concept: This document details fundamental CSS properties for controlling text appearance and image dimensions. Specifically, it covers `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-weight`, `text-align`, and image height/width adjustments. Understanding these properties is crucial for creating visually appealing and responsive web pages.
technical_breakdown: CSS properties like `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-weight`, `text-align`, and `font-size` are used to style text elements.
The `img` element's `height` and `width` attributes and CSS properties control image dimensions, preventing layout shifts upon image loading.
External CSS files are the most common method for managing styles, linking them via the `<link>` tag in the HTML `<head>`.
